This release changes the license. There are no code changes from 0.3.9, so upgrading is safe.

## License change

From 0.4.0, geoveil-cn0 is licensed under **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0** with an attribution term. Research, teaching, personal projects and non-commercial organisations use it free, with credit ("geoveil-cn0 by Miluta Dulea-Flueras") and citation. Commercial use needs a separate license: contact miluta.flueras@cartografie.ro. Versions 0.3.9 and earlier remain MIT.

## Install

```bash
pip install -U geoveil-cn0
```

Wheels for Linux, Windows and macOS on Python 3.9 to 3.12.

## Also released: geoveil-mp 1.0.0

The companion multipath library reached 1.0 today, with SNR wavelet analysis and first Fresnel zone mapping in Rust. See the [geoveil-mp v1.0.0 release](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-mp/releases/tag/v1.0.0). Both libraries run in production on the [GeoVeil batch platform](https://batch.geoveil-rinex.eu).

**Links:** [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/geoveil-cn0/0.4.0/) · [Changelog](https://github.com/miluta7/geoveil-cn0/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Live platform](https://batch.geoveil-rinex.eu)
